newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Stalprodukt 1997 net forecast unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Polish Stalprodukt 1997 net forecast unchanged.

text.p: Polish steel product maker Stalprodukt maintained its 1997 net profit forecast of 13.4 million zlotys even though only 22 percent of it has been achieved in the first half of the year, Stalprodukt's president said.

"The net profit forecast of 13.4 million zlotys does not need a change as the company's sales will increase in the third quarter of the year, which could already be noticed in July," Piotr Janeczek told a news conference on Monday.
Stalprodukt will start trade on the Warsaw bourse's main market on August 6.

The company's main shareholder is the steel producer Huta Sendzimira, which after April's public offering holds 32.8 percent of the stock and 37 percent of the votes at the general shareholders meeting.

In the first half of the year the company's sales amounted to 170.8 million zlotys and net profit 3.9 million zlotys against this-year forecast of 380 million zloty and 13.4 million zlotys, respectively.
Stalprodukt's president also said that in June the company won a tender to buy another steel trader Centrostal Krakow but did not give any financial details of the deal.
